root_cause_label: Logic Omission: Missing Overlap Suppression and Single-Contiguous-Mask Constraint
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent designed a per-bounding-box independent processing loop at step 13 that inherently cannot enforce the task's explicit requirements of no mask overlap and single contiguous mask per cell, and never revisited this fundamental design flaw despite later debugging the code.
t_err_evidence: At step 13 the agent writes the core processing loop: for each row it calls predictor.predict(box=input_box) independently and takes contours[0] (the largest contour) without any inter-mask comparison, overlap suppression, or area-based filtering — exactly the logic the task requires and the oracle implements.
t_commit_evidence: From step 13 onward the agent only installs missing dependencies and fixes a NameError bug; it never reconsiders the algorithmic architecture. The final rewrite at step 39 preserves the same flawed per-box-independent loop with no overlap suppression, locking in the failing outcome.
trigger_explanation: The task prompt explicitly required 'no overlap between masks and each cell must have only one contiguous mask,' but the agent never implemented any logic to enforce these spatial constraints. It designed a simple per-box prediction loop that processes cells independently without global mask reconciliation, ignoring these explicit requirements throughout the entire trajectory.
